blocks.text: Filipino series “Love at First Spike” has secured a nomination in the Kids: Live Action category at the 2026 International Emmy Awards. The series, produced by ABS-CBN Studios and iWant, was among the nominees for the prestigious awards, whose list was released on Wednesday, Sept. 23. “Love at First Spike” is up against Chile’s “31 Minutos: Calurosa Navidad,” the Netherlands’ “De Achterblijvers” [Those Left Behind] and the United Kingdom’s “Dexter Procter: The Ten Year Old Doctor” for the accolade. The Filipino volleyball-themed romantic comedy series is directed by Ivan Andrew Payawal and stars Emilio Daez, Reign Parani, Sean Tristan and River Joseph, among others. […]...
